title: Set light standards and templates
summary: A few shared standards and templates help teams work consistently without slowing them down. Keep them light and explain why each one exists.

beginner: Pick the two or three practices that cause the most confusion.
Write a short standard for each, such as what a product brief must cover.
Provide a template with an example.
Ask teams for feedback after they use them.
intermediate: Review standards with teams every few months.
experienced: Align standards across product, design and engineering.
Use standards to support assessments or reviews where needed.

canDelegateTo.task: Edit standards and templates for clarity

toolExamples.confluence: Keep templates in one shared space.
toolExamples.notion: Publish each standard with an example.
